contract.task_clause:
How did Eratosthenes estimate the size of the Earth in 240 B.C.?
Option A: By measuring the maximum altitude of the Sun in two cities at different latitudes at the same time on the same day.
Option B: By measuring the size of Earth's shadow on the Moon during a lunar eclipse.
Option C: By finding a place on Earth where the Sun passes directly overhead.
Option D: By sending fleets of ships around the Earth.
